applies_to: portfolio/statistical sums derived from frozen case cash/R

boundary_contract.timestamps: exact integer UTC seconds/milliseconds as already defined; no Decimal conversion needed
boundary_contract.comparison: exact Decimal ordering/equality on the design-scope serialized values; no tolerance
boundary_contract.fixed_U: serialized once from reference scenario/base-cost design construction and consumed by ledger unchanged
boundary_contract.quantity: serialized scenario quantity from design/execution binding; ledger consumes unchanged
boundary_contract.funding_rates: source Decimal strings parsed directly at ledger precision80; never rounded through design precision50 unless used by a design rule, which v4.1 does not permit

repeating_decimal_witnesses.name: one_third_boundary
repeating_decimal_witnesses.design_rule: compute/quantize under precision50 then serialize; ledger must parse exact serialized value rather than recompute 1/3 under precision80

repeating_decimal_witnesses.name: lot_division_boundary
repeating_decimal_witnesses.design_rule: contract count flooring is a design/execution operation at precision50; ledger may not refloor at precision80

repeating_decimal_witnesses.name: payoff_equality
repeating_decimal_witnesses.design_rule: equality passes exactly under precision50; ledger precision cannot alter admission
